welcome_message: A judge experiment: grade your app's answers with an LLM judge, check the eval set can fail first, keep every vote on the trace, and send what the judge fails to a person.

project_name.description: Project name (lowercase letters, digits and underscores)
project_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Use 3 to 41 lowercase letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter.

catalog.description: Unity Catalog catalog for the eval set and the results (you need to be able to create a schema in it)

schema.description: Schema for the eval set and the results (created if missing, in the dev target it gets your name)
schema.pattern_match_failure_message: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

judge_model.description: The judge's model, as provider:/name (a serving endpoint, or databricks:/system.ai.<model> on Unity Catalog model services)
judge_model.pattern_match_failure_message: Write it as provider:/name, for example databricks:/databricks-claude-opus-5-5.

jury_models.description: Optional: more judges to compare as a jury, comma-separated (leave empty for one judge)

min_failures.description: Known-bad answers the set needs before judging starts (96 gives a catch rate about 10 points each way)
